title: BerryKeep default global rendezvous catalog
description: Public defaults offered when creating a new cluster on its first server node.

rendezvous_services.description: An empty list intentionally advertises no default service. Array order is display order, not a failover guarantee.

id.description: Stable identifier, unique within the catalog; keep it when renaming or moving a service.

name.description: Human-readable service name for the initial setup UI.

url.description: HTTPS origin, including any required port. Only an empty path or / is supported in v1. Userinfo, query strings and fragments are forbidden. Consumers also validate the parsed host and port and reject duplicate canonical URLs.

global_registration_enabled.description: Every catalog entry supports independent clusters and requires cluster self-registration.
